title: tincraft 2
description: a improved version of the original tincraft mod
body:
# Tincraft 2

Tincraft 2 is a complete rewrite and continuation of the original Tincraft mod. It starts with the core tin-related content from the first version and is designed to expand into a larger, more modular and maintainable project over time.

This rewrite focuses on:

* Cleaner and more maintainable code
* Better compatibility with modern mod loaders
* A modular structure that allows easier feature expansion
* Long-term support for future Minecraft versions

## ✨ Features

Currently implemented content:

* Tin Ore – generates in the world and can be mined
* Tin Ingot – basic crafting material
* Tin Block – storage block for tin

Planned additions (subject to change):

* Machines and processing systems
* Expanded crafting and progression mechanics
* Integration with other mods

## 📦 Purpose

Tincraft 2 aims to provide a solid foundation for a tin-based progression system that can be used both standalone and as part of modpacks.

The goal is not just to add items, but to build a consistent and expandable system around tin as a resource.

## ⚠️ Development Status

This mod is currently in active development.

That means:

* Features may be incomplete or missing
* Content may change between versions
* Bugs may occur

You can expect regular updates and improvements over time.

## 🐞 Issues & Feedback

If you encounter bugs or have suggestions, please report them here:

https://github.com/randomusert-s-mods/tincraft_rewriten/issues

Include as much detail as possible (logs, steps to reproduce, etc.) to help with fixing issues faster.

## 🛠️ Dependencies
### Fabric
* Fabric API
* Architectury API
* TinCore
### NeoForge
* Architectury API
* TinCore
